'''Arbular''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Arbular system/Legends|Arbular system]], a part of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]]&mdash;fought from [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]] to [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] between the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], the group of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and being under the influence of<ref name="EGTW" /> the Aqualish [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Ando/Legends|Ando]],<ref name="CSWE Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref> and<ref name="EGTW" /> the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|30|Andosha II}}</ref>&mdash;the forces of the Spiverelda prevailed over those of the Free Colonies at an [[Battle of Arbular|engagement]] at Arbular.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arbular was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Arbular [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square Q-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
